mechanism_narrative: Increasing GDP growth (GDPC1) reflects expanding economic activity, which should positively impact corporate earnings and drive S&P 500 forward returns higher over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 growth is positive but SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of cases, this hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals labor market tightening, which may lead to wage inflation and negatively impact corporate profit margins, reducing S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE falls below 4% but SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, this hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) combined with increasing housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong economic expansion, which should boost corporate revenues and increase S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If both INDPRO and HOUST are rising but SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 30% of cases, this hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) during a monetary easing cycle reduces borrowing costs and increases consumer and business spending, leading to higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS decreases by 0.25% in the last month
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases but SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of cases, this hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Growth in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates a strong labor market, which should positively impact consumer spending and corporate revenues, leading to higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS growth is positive but SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases, this hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real sales (RSAFS) reflects strong consumer demand, which should positively impact corporate revenues and increase S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases by $500 million in the last month
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases but SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of cases, this hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and falling unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates tightening monetary conditions, which may negatively impact corporate borrowing costs and reduce S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If both FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE falls but SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 30% of cases, this hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A slowdown in housing starts (HOUST) during a late-cycle expansion indicates weakening demand, which should negatively impact related industries and reduce S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST growth slows by more than 5% year-over-year
failure_condition: If HOUST growth slows but SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 40% of cases, this hypothesis is rejected.
